title: Particles & Emphasis: 嘛, 吧 (weighing options), …的, 正…着呢, 又不 / 又没, 就是, 三天没…了
description: That's obvious (嘛), weighing two options (吧), certainty (的), in the middle of (正…着呢), emphatic negation (又不), stubborn 就是, and how long since.

points.title: …嘛: it's obvious
points.summary: 嘛 (ma) at the end = 'come on, that's obvious'. Not a question.
points.body:
- 他是你哥哥**嘛**，当然会帮你.
- 有问题就问老师**嘛**.
examples: If you have a question, just ask the teacher — simple.

points.title: A 吧，…；B 吧，…: weighing options
points.summary: Option 1 + 吧，problem; option 2 + 吧，problem = I can't decide.
points.body: - 去**吧**，太远；不去**吧**，又不太好.
examples: If I go, it's too far; if I don't, it's not very nice either.

points.title: …的: certainty
points.summary: 的 at the end adds 'definitely, you can count on it', often with 会.
examples: Don't worry, I won't tell anyone.

points.title: 正(在) + verb + 着 + 呢
points.summary: The full progressive: 正 / 正在 + verb + 着 + (object) + 呢.

points.title: 又不 / 又没: (but) it's not as if
points.summary: 又 + 不 / 没 strengthens a negative rebuttal: 'it's not like …'.
points.body:
- 我**又不**是小孩子.
- 你**又没**去过，怎么知道不好玩?
examples: It's not as if I'm a child!

points.title: 就是 + verb: just (won't)
points.summary: 就是 before a verb = stubbornly, simply (就是不想去).
points.body: - 不管我怎么说，他**就是**不听.
examples: I just don't want to go.

points.title: Duration + 没 + verb + 了
points.summary: How long something hasn't happened: 三天没吃饭了 (haven't eaten for three days).
examples: I haven't seen him for a year.

questions.prompt: What does 嘛 add in 「{他|tā}{是|shì}{你|nǐ}{哥哥|gēge}{嘛|ma}，{当然|dāngrán}{会|huì}{帮|bāng}{你|nǐ}。」?
notes: That would be 啊 / 呀.
questions.translation: He's your brother — of course he'll help you.

questions.prompt: {有|yǒu}{问题|wèntí}{就|jiù}{问|wèn}{老师|lǎoshī}（　），{别|bié}{不好意思|bù hǎoyìsi}。
notes: 吗 would make it a question.
questions.translation: If you have a question, just ask the teacher — don't be shy.
If I go, it's too far; if I don't, it's not very nice either.

questions.prompt: What is the speaker doing in 「{买|mǎi}{吧|ba}，{太|tài}{贵|guì}；{不|bù}{买|mǎi}{吧|ba}，{又|yòu}{很|hěn}{喜欢|xǐhuan}。」?
questions.explanation: Option 吧，… ; option 吧，… = **can't decide**.
questions.translation: If I buy it, it's too expensive; if I don't, I really like it.
Don't worry, I won't tell anyone.

questions.prompt: {你|nǐ}{现在|xiànzài}{别|bié}{找|zhǎo}{他|tā}，{他|tā}{正在|zhèngzài}{开|kāi}（　）{会|huì}{呢|ne}。
questions.translation: Don't look for him now — he's in a meeting.

notes: 正 doesn't go with 了.

questions.prompt: {我|wǒ}（　）{不|bú}{是|shì}{小孩子|xiǎo háizi}，{你|nǐ}{别|bié}{管|guǎn}{我|wǒ}！
questions.translation: It's not as if I'm a child — stop bossing me around!

questions.prompt: What does 「{你|nǐ}{又|yòu}{没|méi}{去|qù}{过|guo}，{怎么|zěnme}{知道|zhīdào}{不|bù}{好玩|hǎowán}？」 mean?

notes: 但是 needs a contrast before it.
questions.translation: I just don't want to go — stop going on about it.

notes: 但是 can't follow the subject here.
questions.translation: No matter what I say, he simply won't listen.

notes: 没有了 can't go before a verb like this.
questions.translation: He's ill — he hasn't eaten for three days.

questions.prompt: Which one means 'I haven't seen him for a year'?
questions.translation: I haven't seen him for a year.
